About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About Bybit and this role

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with a distributed workforce operating across many countries and time zones around the clock. Our people work in a fast-moving, highly regulated industry where speed, trust, and clarity matter every day.

This is a new role. As Bybit scales, how people experience the company has to be designed on purpose, not left to chance. The Head of Employee Experience & Innovation will build that experience end to end: the offices we work in, how employees hear from leadership, how we come together, and how engaged and connected people feel.

Mission

Make Bybit a place where talented people across every location feel informed, connected, and able to do their best work, and use data and new ideas, including AI, to keep improving that experience as we grow.

Key responsibilities

Employee engagement

• 

Design and run the employee listening strategy: engagement surveys, pulse checks, lifecycle surveys, and exit insights.

• 

Turn results into action plans with leaders, and track progress so employees see their feedback lead to change.

• 

Shape the employee journey from onboarding to exit, removing friction at key moments.

• 

Lead recognition programs and culture initiatives that reinforce Bybit's values.

• 

Build community and belonging programs, including employee networks and wellbeing initiatives.

Internal events

• 

Own the internal events calendar: all-hands, town halls, leadership offsites, team celebrations, and company milestones.

• 

Deliver events across locations and formats (in person, hybrid, virtual) with clear goals, budgets, and measures of success.

• 

Ensure events are inclusive and respectful of the cultural and religious diversity of our workforce.

• 

Manage vendors, budgets, and logistics with strong cost discipline.

Internal communications

• 

Build the internal communications strategy and editorial calendar.

• 

Own and manage all internal communications channels: the intranet, company newsletter, all-company email, Slack or Lark channels, office digital screens, and leadership updates.

• 

Own intranet content management end to end: content strategy, site structure, governance, publishing workflows, and keeping information accurate and current.

• 

Set content standards and train content owners across functions so every team publishes clearly and consistently.

• 

Partner with the CEO, executives, and the CPO on leadership messaging, change communications, and announcements.

• 

Coordinate with Corporate Communications, Legal, and Compliance so sensitive or regulated messages are accurate and consistent.

• 

Measure reach and understanding, and keep improving how information flows across the company.

Innovation

• 

Bring new tools and ideas to the employee experience, including AI-enabled self-service, chat assistants, and automation of routine People processes.

• 

Run small pilots, measure results, and scale what works.

• 

Work with HR Technology and IT to keep the People tech stack simple, connected, and easy to use.

Leadership

• 

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team across the four areas above.

• 

Own the function's budget and vendor relationships.

• 

Serve as a member of the People Leadership Team and a trusted partner to senior business leaders.

Workplace operations

• 

Lead the global Workplace Operations team that manages Bybit's offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Malaysia, and other offices across APAC and EMEA.

• 

Own office strategy and space planning, including openings, moves, expansions, and fit-outs, in partnership with Finance.

• 

Set consistent workplace standards across all sites: facilities, health and safety, front desk, amenities, and spaces that support diverse needs such as prayer and wellness rooms.

• 

Manage facilities vendors, service contracts, and office budgets with strong cost discipline.

• 

Partner with IT, Security, and Legal on physical security, access, business continuity, and emergency response.

• 

Use occupancy data and employee feedback to design offices people want to work in.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

Area

Outcome

Workplace operations

Consistent workplace standards across all four office locations; office space plan and budget agreed with Finance

Engagement

Company-wide listening program launched, with action plans owned by every executive

Internal events

Annual events calendar and budget set; flagship all-hands and leadership offsite delivered

Internal communications

Intranet organized with clear content owners and governance; channel strategy and editorial rhythm in place

Innovation

At least two People experience pilots (e.g., AI self-service) tested and measured

Team

Function fully staffed with clear roles and goals

What you bring

Requirements

• 

12+ years in People, employee experience, workplace, or internal communications, with 5+ years leading teams.

• 

Proven ownership of at least two of: multi-country workplace or office operations, employee engagement, internal communications, or large-scale internal events.

• 

Experience managing an intranet or other internal communications platforms, including content governance.

• 

Experience in a high-growth, global company with employees in multiple countries.

• 

Strong analytical skills: comfortable turning survey, occupancy, and channel data into decisions.

• 

Excellent writing and editorial judgment, including drafting for senior executives.

• 

Track record of managing budgets and vendors.

• 

Fluent English.

Preferred

• 

Experience in fintech, crypto, financial services, or another regulated industry.

• 

Experience working in the Gulf region and across Asia and Europe.

• 

Hands-on use of AI and automation to improve employee services.

• 

Familiarity with HRIS, engagement, and communications platforms (e.g., Workday, Culture Amp, Lark, Slack).

• 

Arabic or Mandarin is a plus.

How you lead

• 

Builder. You create programs from a blank page and scale them as the company grows.

• 

Data-driven. You measure what matters and use it to decide where to invest.

• 

Executive presence. You earn the trust of the CEO and senior leaders and can push back with care.

• 

Global mindset. You design for many cultures, languages, and time zones, not one headquarters.

• 

Bias for action. You move fast, test ideas, and learn from what doesn't work.

• 

Integrity. You handle sensitive information and messages with discretion and judgment.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 
As a Ping Incident Escalations Manager, you will provide Level 2 incident response and escalation support within the Cyber Security Engineering team. You will help coordinate complex security incidents, improve incident readiness, and ensure that lessons learned are converted into practical improvements.

This is an individual contributor role, combining technical incident response experience with strong operational coordination. You will work closely with CSE engineers and cross-functional teams to maintain momentum during incidents, support tabletop exercises, and improve our incident response capability.

You will

• Act as a Level 2 escalation point for CSE engineers during complex or high-risk security incidents

• Coordinate incident response across Cyber Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, IT, Product, and other relevant teams

• Establish incident priorities, ownership, actions, dependencies, and communication cadence

• Support investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and validation activities

• Maintain accurate incident timelines, decision records, action logs, and stakeholder updates

• Prepare and support cyber security tabletop exercises, including scenarios, injects, facilitation, and follow-up actions

• Develop and improve incident response playbooks, runbooks, escalation paths, and readiness procedures

• Lead or support post-incident reviews and ensure lessons learned are converted into tracked improvements

• Identify recurring response gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for automation or process improvement

• Participate in the Cyber Security Engineering on-call or escalation rota, where required

• Collaborate cross-functionally to improve incident response readiness and security outcomes

Requirements

• Experience in cyber security engineering, incident response, security operations, SRE, or technical operations

• Experience responding to or coordinating security incidents involving multiple teams

• Strong operational judgement and the ability to make decisions under pressure and with incomplete information

• Experience acting as an incident lead, technical lead, escalation point, or senior responder

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience creating or improving incident response playbooks, runbooks, procedures, or post-incident reviews

• Experience conducting, facilitating, or supporting tabletop or operational readiness exercises

• Ability to influence and coordinate teams without direct reporting authority

• Experience with security investigation and response tooling, such as SIEM, EDR, cloud logging, identity telemetry, or security orchestration platforms

• Strong understanding of cloud environments, preferably AWS and/or GCP

• Understanding of enterprise and SaaS operational environments

• On-call and escalation participation is a requirement for this position

You have an advantage if:

• Experience with Google SecOps and YARA-L

• Experience with security orchestration, automation, and bespoke scripting

• Experience working with Kubernetes and Docker in development or incident response contexts

• Experience with threat intelligence, detection engineering, EDR, identity response, or cloud forensics

• Experience improving incident response maturity, operational metrics, or security operating procedures

Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to architect, build, and optimize large-scale data platforms using Python, PySpark, Apache Spark, Databricks, Parquet, and Delta Lake. This is an individual-contributor role providing technical direction while remaining involved in design, coding, performance tuning, and production support across Azure and GCP. Snowflake is a preferred secondary skill.

Responsibilities:
• Architect and deliver scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi-terabyte datasets and billions of records, supporting batch, incremental, CDC, near-real-time, and streaming workloads.
• Build reusable, reliable pipelines and frameworks for ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, backfills, schema evolution, and data publishing.
• Lead Databricks and lakehouse engineering, including Delta Lake table design, workflows, governance, deployment, monitoring, and cost management.
• Diagnose and optimize Spark workloads using execution plans and metrics; resolve skew, inefficient joins, shuffles, memory pressure, and storage issues through sound partitioning, caching, and resource strategies.
• Define engineering standards for modular Python/PySpark code, testing, CI/CD, logging, observability, security, and operational readiness.
• Own complex production issues through root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes; improve pipeline reliability, data quality, recovery, performance, and cloud cost.
• Provide technical direction across teams through architecture reviews, reference patterns, design decisions, and mentoring; influence without direct people-management responsibility.
• Partner with data science, product, architecture, cloud, security, and operations teams to translate needs into secure, scalable solutions and balance performance, reliability, cost, and delivery.

Qualifications
Required
• 10+ Years of software development experience required
• Deep hands-on expertise in Python, PySpark, Apache Spark, Databricks, Parquet, Delta Lake, distributed computing, and large-scale ETL/ELT. 
• Proven delivery and troubleshooting of multi-terabyte production workloads
• Strong Spark performance tuning and pipeline reliability skills. 
• Experience with Azure and GCP. Strong software engineering practices, analytical problem-solving, communication, ownership, and technical influence.
Preferred
• Snowflake development, integration, tuning, and cost optimization; 
• Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory or Airflow; Structured Streaming, Kafka or Event Hubs; large-scale feature engineering; 
• Experience with cloud security, governance, and cost controls.

The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This job will design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to detect and prevent fraud across our Crypto and Debit Card portfolios. You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, fraud strategy, risk operations, and product teams to protect customers and reduce losses through AI/ML solutions.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities: 

• Develop and optimize machine learning models for various applications.
• Preprocess and analyze large datasets to extract meaningful insights.
• Deploy ML solutions into production environments using appropriate tools and frameworks.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into products and services.
• Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and tools for data processing and model deployment.
• Several years of experience in designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning models.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Responsibilities:

• Develop and optimize ML models to detect fraud across debit card transactions (card-present and card-not-present), crypto buy/sell/transfer activity, account takeover, and scams.
• Deploy and maintain ML solutions in production, including feature pipelines, model serving, and champion/challenger testing.
• Collaborate with fraud strategy, risk operations, product, and engineering teams to integrate models into decisioning systems.
• Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models (fraud capture, false positive and decline rates, drift), making necessary adjustments and supporting retraining cycles.
• Produce model documentation that meets model risk management and governance standards.
• Contribute to team best practices through code reviews and knowledge sharing, and support the growth of junior engineers.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience building fraud detection or risk models in payments, card issuing, banking, or crypto.
• Proficiency with gradient-boosted models (XGBoost, LightGBM); familiarity with deep learning approaches such as sequence models or graph-based methods is a plus.
• Understanding of card payment flows (authorizations, chargebacks, disputes) or crypto transaction and wallet risk.
• Familiarity with model explainability and governance in a regulated financial services environment.
• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field.

PayPal

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI team, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end — from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface — and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows, or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on.

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications — not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI during technical evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own features end to end — database schema, backend services, APIs, and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface — operating as an owner rather than a ticket-taker.
  • Build full-stack web applications: responsive, production-grade frontends using React/Next.js, backed by well-designed REST APIs and backend services.
  • Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces..
  • Build and productionize AI-agentified features — agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling — grounded in 1–2 years of hands-on experience with these systems.
  • Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers.
  • Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy.
  • Design and optimize relational database schemas, including joins, indexing, and query performance tuning.
  • Build clean, well-tested, production-grade frontend and backend code that others can read, test, and extend.
  • Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked.
  • Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos.

Required Qualifications 

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack development (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation).
  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating AI-agentified applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, or LLM-powered features) in production..
  • Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery.

Technical Skills — Applied AI

  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience building AI-agentified applications, including agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, ADK, or equivalent), tool/function-calling for LLMs.
  • Practical understanding of AI-specific considerations: latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

Technical Skills — Full Stack

  • Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next.js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing/SSR).
  • Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs.
  • Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization.

Technical Skills — Distributed Systems & Reliability

  • Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling.
  • Reliability engineering fundamentals: observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, error budgets, and operational runbooks.
  • Ability to reason about system design trade-offs and build scalable, resilient solutions under ambiguity.

Soft Skills

  • Proactive communication — shares updates without being asked and flags blockers early.
  • Asks the right questions — clarifies requirements upfront before jumping into implementation.
  • Ownership mindset — treats the project as their own rather than just completing tickets.
  • Transparency — speaks up when something is unclear instead of making assumptions.
  • Strong analytical mindset to break down complex or ambiguous problems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (ADK, LangGraph, or similar) beyond individual projects — production deployment experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with API documentation standards (Swagger/OpenAPI).
  • Basic DevOps awareness (Docker, CI/CD) and Git/version-control best practices.
  • Testing experience across unit and integration levels.
  • Experience with modern web app tooling — component libraries (e.g., Tailwind, MUI) and state management (e.g., Redux, Zustand).
  • Exposure to cloud-native development (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containers and infrastructure as code.

7a5f0945ee12ad8b.description:
Purpose of the Role:-
To own and drive product strategy for a consumer-facing (B2C) product area at Park+ — from identifying user problems to shipping and scaling AI-powered solutions. The role focuses on building products used by millions of vehicle owners, with AI and automation at the core of how problems get solved.

Key Responsibilities:-
Product Ownership: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for a consumer-facing product area — from discovery and problem definition to roadmap, execution, and post-launch iteration.
-
Roadmap & Prioritization: Translate user research, behavioral data, and business goals into a clear, prioritized product roadmap.
-
AI & Automation: Identify opportunities to apply AI/automation — LLMs, ML models, RAG, OCR — to reduce manual effort, improve product experience, or unlock new capabilities.
AI Feature Delivery : Own end-to-end delivery for at least one AI-powered or automated feature, from idea to adoption, partnering closely with engineering and data teams.
Metrics & Experimentation: Define and track success metrics for every feature shipped; run experiments (A/B tests, funnel analysis) to validate impact.
-
Customer Focus: Deeply understand the end consumer through user interviews, support tickets, analytics, and market research; represent their voice in every decision.
-
Stakeholder Communication : Communicate roadmap, outcomes, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
-
Data & Insights: Track product and funnel metrics (activation, retention, conversion, CAC/LTV, etc.) and derive actionable insights to improve the product experience.
-
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Business/Growth teams to ship and scale features end-to-end.
Candidate Profile – Skills & Competencies

• 3–6 years of experience in Product Management, with proven ownership of consumer-facing (B2C) products

• Hands-on experience building or driving adoption of AI/automation-powered product features (LLMs, ML models, RAG pipelines, OCR automation, chatbots, recommendation engines, etc.)

• Strong grasp of product metrics and funnel thinking — comfortable citing real numbers (conversion lift, CAC reduction, retention improvement) tied to your work

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, and business teams

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable with Excel, SQL, and analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar) for data-driven decision-making

• High ownership, adaptability, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Preferred Qualifications
• B.Tech

Key Interactions
- Internal: Engineering, Design, Data Science, Business/Growth teams, Leadership
- External: AI/ML tooling vendors, research & UX agencies, Consultants (if applicable)
